title: Part 6
content_zh: When the orders are consistently enforced, the army will be disciplined. When they are not, the army will be useless. Orders must be as clear as the sun and moon, and as trustworthy as the four seasons.
content_en: When the orders are consistently enforced, the army will be disciplined. When they are not, the army will be useless. Orders must be as clear as the sun and moon, and as trustworthy as the four seasons.
